title: Actionable Meta-Requirements for AI Robustness Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2610.14356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-enabled systems must remain dependable when the conditions under which they operate change (e.g., due to input perturbations, distribution shifts, or changes in external dependencies). This makes robustness auditing of such systems important for judging whether the available evidence is sufficient to support a defined robustness conclusion. However, designing an AI robustness auditing framework is challenging. A key unresolved issue is determining the requirements such a framework should support; these requirements have not yet been consolidated. We address this gap through meta-requirements: higher-order requirements specifying what a class of auditing frameworks should support. In design science research, literature and domain experts are common sources of meta-requirements; accordingly, we derive the initial set from literature and validate and refine it with practitioners. translated_title: 面向AI鲁棒性审计的可操作元需求
translated_abstract: 支持AI的系统在运行条件发生变化时（例如由于输入扰动、分布偏移或外部依赖的变化）必须保持可靠。这使得对此类系统的鲁棒性审计变得十分重要，可用于判断现有证据是否足以支持特定的鲁棒性结论。然而，设计AI鲁棒性审计框架极具挑战性。一个尚未解决的关键问题在于确定此类框架应支持哪些需求；而这些需求目前尚未被系统整合。我们通过“元需求”来填补这一空白：元需求是规定一类审计框架应支持什么的高阶需求。在设计科学研究（Design Science Research）中，文献和领域专家是元需求的常见来源；因此，我们从文献中推导出初始需求集，并与从业者合作进行验证和完善。我们的系统性文献综述从2,890条记录中筛选保留了74条……
tldr: 本文提出了AI鲁棒性审计的可操作元需求，即规定一类审计框架应支持什么的高阶需求，通过系统性文献综述推导并与领域从业者验证完善，填补了此类框架需求尚未整合的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper derives actionable meta-requirements—higher-order requirements specifying what a class of AI robustness auditing frameworks should support—through a systematic literature review, validated and refined with practitioners, addressing the gap that such requirements have not yet been consolidated.
